commentary.text: 90+7' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+5' Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
90+4' Tyler Adams (Bournemouth) is cautioned by the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
90+4' Enes Unal is not given a chance to finish after receiving a sweet pass by Alejandro Jimenez (Bournemouth).

90+3' Eli Junior Kroupi (Bournemouth) is free in the box and Marcus Tavernier finds him with a pass, but his powerful shot skims just past the right post. Good chance! The ball goes out of play and Brentford will have a goal kick.
90+2' The foul by Alejandro Jimenez (Bournemouth) was seen by Craig Pawson who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.

90+1' A through ball from Eli Junior Kroupi (Bournemouth) fails to reach Enes Unal as one of the defending players reacts brilliantly to intercept the effort. If the pass had been produced a little bit earlier, Enes Unal could have got into a promising position.
90' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.

89' Mathias Jensen sends over a penetrating corner which finds the head of Kevin Schade (Brentford), but his effort from close range is disappointing and goes high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Bournemouth will have a goal kick.
88' Mathias Jensen (Brentford) steps up to send the ball in.
88' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Mathias Jensen (Brentford), is intercepted by the opposition's defence. The referee blows his whistle, Brentford are awarded a corner kick.
87' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Keane Lewis-Potter (Brentford) comes onto the pitch so that Dango Ouattara can be given a rest.
86' Amine Adli (Bournemouth) steadies himself and bends in a shot from the edge of the box towards the top of the net, but Caoimhin Kelleher has it covered and makes a comfortable save.
85' Michael Kayode (Brentford) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
84' Kevin Schade (Brentford) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
84' The ball possession at the moment is 48:52.
81' Mathias Jensen (Brentford) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates.

80' Igor Thiago makes a nice run and receives a pin-point long through ball from Mikkel Damsgaard (Brentford). It would probably have put him one-on-one with the keeper, but one of the defenders makes a great block. The ball goes behind for a corner. Brentford will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
80' Substitution. Evanilson walks off the pitch and Enes Unal (Bournemouth) comes on as a substitute.
79' A goal, which was scored by Evanilson (Bournemouth), was disallowed due to offside.
77' Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth) gathers the ball inside the box and produces a snap shot. The ball, though, only brushes the left post.

76' Sepp van den Berg (Brentford) creates himself some space inside the goalmouth and connects with the resulting free kick. His header would have probably ended up low in the middle of the goal, but Djordje Petrovic pulls off a superb reflex save to thwart him.
75' It seemed like Mathias Jensen (Brentford) was going to take a quick free kick, but instead he is going to send the ball inside the penalty box for his teammates.
74' Andoni Iraola prepares a substitution. Ryan Christie is replaced by Eli Junior Kroupi (Bournemouth).
74' Rayan comes off the pitch to be replaced by Amine Adli (Bournemouth).
74' Poor challenge! Alex Scott (Bournemouth) is penalised for tripping and Craig Pawson blows his whistle. Brentford win a free kick.

72' What a wasted opportunity by Dango Ouattara (Brentford)! He creates some space for himself inside the penalty box and unleashes a decent strike towards the middle of the net, but Djordje Petrovic makes a comfortable save to thwart him.
71' Alex Scott (Bournemouth) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.
71' Alex Scott (Bournemouth) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. Bournemouth force their opponents to concede a corner.
68' Dango Ouattara (Brentford) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
66' Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.
64' The resulting free kick from Mathias Jensen (Brentford) ends up in the gloves of the keeper.
63' Tyler Adams (Bournemouth) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. Brentford are awarded the free kick.
62' Here's the change. Jordan Henderson leaves the pitch and Yegor Yarmolyuk (Brentford) comes on as a substitute.
60' Craig Pawson shows a yellow card to Mathias Jensen (Brentford) for his blatant foul.
57' The Bournemouth players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
55' Dango Ouattara (Brentford) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.

53' Alejandro Jimenez (Bournemouth) lacks options so fires a shot at goal from the edge of box, but it's a wasted effort and goes high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Brentford will have a goal kick.
51' The current number of corner kicks is 3:1.
48' Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth) latches onto a good pass inside the box and shoots. The effort beats the keeper, but deflects off the left post to safety.
46' Brentford hold the ball and display nice passing from player to player.
46' Craig Pawson blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+3' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+2' Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth) has a great chance inside the six-yard box, shoots to the bottom left corner, but Caoimhin Kelleher pulls off an exquisite save to deny him.
45' There will be a minimum of 2 min. of added time.
45' Mathias Jensen (Brentford) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.

45' Kevin Schade (Brentford) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. Brentford have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
44' Adrien Truffert (Bournemouth) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
43' Bournemouth are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
41' Ryan Christie (Bournemouth) sends a long ball across the pitch, but it misses its target. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Brentford.
40' Caoimhin Kelleher leaps to collect the ball from the corner which was sent over by Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth).
40' A cross from Alejandro Jimenez (Bournemouth) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety. Bournemouth will have a chance to score from a corner kick.

37' Ryan Christie (Bournemouth) receives a brilliant pass and wastes a big opportunity as his shot from inside the penalty area flies narrowly wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Brentford.
36' Some great controlled play and passing from Bournemouth. They are increasing their possession of the ball and trying to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.

34' Rayan plays a lofted pass into the six-yard box. James Hill (Bournemouth) gets his head on the ball but balloons it high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Brentford.
34' Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.
34' The ball is cleared after Rayan (Bournemouth) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Bournemouth.
33' Tyler Adams (Bournemouth) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Craig Pawson blows his whistle for a foul. Brentford earn a free kick.
32' Alex Scott (Bournemouth) jinks his way past two defenders and from the edge of the box has an effort which goes just over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Brentford.
31' Ryan Christie (Bournemouth) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
30' Bournemouth take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.

29' Tyler Adams (Bournemouth) whips the ball into the box and Marcus Tavernier takes a perfect touch to control it, but one of the defenders does well to intercept. The referee points to the corner flag and Bournemouth will take a corner.
28' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 1:1.
26' Mathias Jensen (Brentford) sends a long ball forward to Dango Ouattara, but he put too much power and the chance is gone.
24' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Mikkel Damsgaard (Brentford) is thwarted and cleared to safety.

24' Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth) finds some space on the edge of the box after some nice individual play and curls a shot in on goal, but the ball flies just wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Brentford will have a goal kick.
22' Evanilson (Bournemouth) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Brentford.
22' Jordan Henderson (Brentford) commits a rough challenge and Craig Pawson blows his whistle for an infringement. Bournemouth are awarded a free kick.
21' Keith Andrews is forced to make a change. Rico Henry is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by Kristoffer Ajer (Brentford).
20' Rico Henry (Brentford) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
18' Dango Ouattara (Brentford) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
17' Brentford control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
13' Here's the current ball possession statistics for both teams – 50:50.
9' Bournemouth string together a series of short passes.
8' Dangerous play by Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth). Craig Pawson blows his whistle for a foul. A free kick has been awarded to Brentford.
5' Nathan Michael Collins (Brentford) feels very aggrieved after the referee stops play for a foul that he commits while in possession of the ball. A free kick has been awarded to Bournemouth.
2' Brentford seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
1' Igor Thiago (Brentford) attempts to slip the ball through the defence, but is unable to find any of his teammates.
1' The first half has just begun.
